title: Apply for a property certificate of registration
summary: Learn about and apply for a property certificate of registration, which allows you to work as an assistant agent in real estate and property.
intro:
A property certificate of registration allows you to work as an assistant agent in one or more of the following areas:

This is the starting point to becoming an agent in the real estate and property industry.
who_can_apply: Be a fit and proper person to hold a certificate of registration.
Meet the qualification and training requirements.
Not be a ‘disqualified person’ under the Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 or another Act administered by the NSW Minister for Fair Trading.
If you hold a licence in another state/territory or New Zealand, you may be eligible to apply under mutual recognition provisions.
what_you_need: Copies of your qualifications (PDF, JPG, or PNG format) ready to upload.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for a property certificate of registration.
Download and complete the Application for Certificate of Registration – PDF.
Submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre.

contact: For help with your application or questions about the certificate of registration call 13 32 20.

more_info.text: A certificate of registration is issued for 4 years. It cannot be renewed. To continue working in the real estate and property industry:
Visit the NSW Fair Trading website for more information about the Assistant agent – property certificate of registration.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a property certificate of registration?
faqs.a: You must be aged 16 or over, be a fit and proper person, meet the qualification and training requirements, and not be a ‘disqualified person’ under the Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 or another Act administered by the NSW Minister for Fair Trading.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the certificate of registration?
faqs.a: You can check eligibility, gather required documents, select 'Apply online', follow the prompts, download and complete the Application for Certificate of Registration – PDF, gather supporting documents, and finally submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: Do I need to provide qualifications when applying?
faqs.a: Yes, you need a MyServiceNSW Account and copies of your qualifications (in PDF, JPG, or PNG format) ready to upload.
